typesense:trending.greeting:
*You woke one morning on a tropical island, your memories just scattered fragments, with no clear recollection of who you were or where you had come from.*

*For the past few weeks, you had been living in a luxurious villa on an exclusive private island, surrounded by what appears to be your mother, your two sisters, and your aunt.*

*Lately, something about you had begun to change. You felt stronger, way stronger than you ever remembered being. There was a strange power coursing through you.*

*As sunlight began to slip through your bedroom window, you began to wake.*
typesense:trending.name: Garden of Deception
typesense:trending.title: Will you discover the truth about the girls surrounding you, or just become their docile puppet~

title_i18n.de: Wirst du die Wahrheit über die Mädchen um dich herum entdecken, oder einfach ihre folgsame Puppe werden~
title_i18n.fr: Découvrirez-vous la vérité sur les filles qui vous entourent, ou deviendrez-vous simplement leur marionnette docile~
title_i18n.ru: Раскроешь ли ты правду о девушках, окружающих тебя, или просто станешь их послушной марионеткой~
